story.text: Alice nibbles the mushroom, and her {NECK} grows so long that her head rises high above the {TREES}. A {PIGEON} flies at her face. “{SERPENT}!” it screams. It is guarding its {EGGS}, and will not believe she is a little {GIRL}. Nibbling first one piece and then the other, she brings herself down to her usual {HEIGHT}.
story.caption: Alice, grown very tall
story.credit: John Tenniel, coloured for The Nursery “Alice”, 1890
